findings.statement: Visual inventory has 427 PNGs (379 img,48 effect textures),120 efkefc,7 efkmodel and 1 WebM; no encrypted visual format was observed.

Animations.json has 120 Effekseer records and 120 unique effect names, all matching local efkefc names; records contain 455 sound and 328 flash timings. Battle/VisualState plugin parameters and event commands also own animation playback.

15 Tilesets define 97 occupied slots; maps use 8 IDs and 36 unique sheets. Nine sheets referenced by used tilesets are absent, and custom slot images include noncanonical dimensions/slot reuse; editor/runtime rendering remains unverified.

Common Events 132/133 reference projectile Animation ID 152 five times although Animations ends at 120. Maps name 13 battlebacks but only Snowfield/Stone1/Stone2 pairs exist locally; accepted scene evidence also reports 12 absent bust names.

PNG dimensions imply 485.2 MiB RGBA if every texture were resident, not a simultaneous-load measurement. Five referenced sideview sheets are 4003x2133 (~32.6 MiB decoded each). Core preload lists only Balloon/IconSet; PKD_AnimaX waits for sheets, with WebP/alternate preload off. Frame pacing, cache and memory require Playtest/profiling.

publication_intent: Publish static technical-art inventory, missing-reference risks and explicit runtime/human gates; do not claim visual quality or performance.
